newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Wiese cut to hold. [CORRECTED 02:20 GMT 30/10]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Wiese cut to hold. [CORRECTED 02:20 GMT 30/10]

text.p: -- Robert Flemings said on Tuesday it had cut its rating for Peru's (corrects from "Chile's") Banco Wiese to hold from long-term buy.

-- Analyst Raquel Lizarraga (corrects spelling of analyst's name) said in a report that Banco Wiese's growth in third quarter revenues "was offset by greater increases in interest expense, operating expense, inflation adjustment and income tax, leading to the less-than-spectacular bottom line."
